# DayPlanner — Task & Implementation Outline

## Source

- ColorLib Calendar V07 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/calendar-07/`)
- New Name: `dayplanner` (`@free-react-templates/dayplanner`)

## Section Breakdown & Fidelity Notes

1. **Header / Navigation:** Month/year indicator with prev/next navigation.
2. **Split Layout:**
   - **Left Panel:** Immersive background image (via Picsum photos seed), selected date header, and daily event list.
   - **Right Panel:** Full interactive calendar grid with weekday headers, days of the month, current day highlight, and date selection handling.
3. **Interactive Features:**
   - Date selection updating the left preview panel.
   - Modal or inline form to add new events.
   - Footer linking to `https://www.componentdock.com/`.

## Design Tokens

- Colors: `#007bff` (primary), `#f8f9fa` (bg), `#1a1a1a` (text).
- Typography: Poppins font family via Google Fonts.
